variants.bio: In the mid-1990s, 31-year-old Johnathan Fitzgerald Michaels worked as an overseas manager at SEGA, leading a heavily crunched development team tasked with creating a 3D compilation game titled Sonic Discoveries. Tragically, the extreme pressure from corporate executives to constantly overwork led to Johnathan suffering a fatal cardiac arrest from overdosing on energy products right at his desk. Following his death, his soul became trapped inside the prototype game disc, which was later uncovered by his daughter, Marilyn, who unknowingly began unravelling the dark mystery of her father’s disappearance.
